stem: Which workstation operating system is most widely adopted in business environments due to its strong compatibility with enterprise applications, management tools, and network infrastructure?
explanation: Windows is the dominant business workstation OS because of its broad enterprise application support, management tooling (Active Directory, Group Policy) and network infrastructure compatibility.

stem: A software development company is setting up new workstations for programmers who frequently use command-line tools, need extensive system configuration capabilities, and prefer a fully open-source platform for building and testing applications. Which OS is best suited for their needs?
explanation: Linux is open source, command-line centric and highly configurable, which suits developers who want a fully open-source build and test platform.

stem: Which workstation OS runs natively only on Apple hardware?
explanation: macOS is licensed to run only on Apple hardware. CentOS (Linux) and ReactOS (a Windows-compatible open-source OS) run on generic PC hardware, and Chrome OS runs on Chromebooks.

stem: Which of the answers listed below refers to an operating system designed for lightweight, low-cost laptops optimized for web-based applications?
explanation: Chrome OS is Google's lightweight, browser-centric OS built for low-cost Chromebooks and web-based applications.

stem: Which mobile operating system restricts app installation strictly to the App Store unless the device is modified?
explanation: iOS is a closed ecosystem: apps come only from Apple's App Store unless the device is jailbroken. Android allows installs from other sources when enabled.

stem: Which of the following answers refers to a mobile OS widely adopted by device manufacturers for its open-source base and flexible customization options?
explanation: Android is built on an open-source base (AOSP) that manufacturers can customize, so it is widely adopted by many device makers.

stem: Which device type is iPadOS specifically developed for?
explanation: iPadOS is Apple's OS for the iPad tablet. iPhones run iOS, Apple Watches run watchOS and Macs run macOS.

stem: Which mobile OS is exclusive to Apple's iPhones?
explanation: iOS runs on the iPhone. iPadOS is for iPads, macOS is for Mac computers and watchOS is for Apple Watch.

stem: A digital artist needs a mobile operating system that supports advanced stylus features. Which OS is the best fit?
explanation: iPadOS runs on the iPad, which supports the Apple Pencil and advanced stylus features. iOS is for iPhones and macOS is a desktop OS.

stem: What are the key characteristics of Android OS? (Select 3 answers)
explanation: Android is an open-source platform with a high level of customization, and apps can be installed from third-party sources when that setting is enabled. A closed ecosystem and App Store-only installs describe iOS.
options: Apps installable from third-party sources (if enabled)
Apps limited only to official App Store
correctAnswer: Apps installable from third-party sources (if enabled)
